note: The homepage's one-liners, one set per week (scripts/UPDATE_WEEK.md, 'The homepage'). Write them with scripts/home.py, never by hand. Every line is optional: a missing or expired line just hides, so the page never shows a stale joke. Same rules as everything else the beat writes (VOICE_GUIDE.md): third person, short and funny, one number at most, nothing from voice/USED.md. title: the Game of the Week headline. preview: the hero line while picks are open (Thursday). live: the hero line once games start, with an 'until' so it expires before it goes stale. kickoff: the line on the next-kickoff card, with an optional 'tag' (where it's played, if that's the story). beerMile, bubble, bonus: the footers on the On the line cards.

7.title: The Beer Mile Bowl
7.preview: Last place has the money. The champ has the rings. Somebody gets closer to the track.

live.text: Hoa won the Beer Mile Bowl before Monday showed up. David gets the night off to study the standings.

kickoff.text: Football in Paris before breakfast. Set your lineup the night before.

7.beerMile: Two of the four play each other this week. That’s the Game of the Week.
7.bubble: Wes is 4-2 on the fewest points above the line. Someone up there likes him.

bonus.text: Named for Adam. Projected for Wes.
